name: uat-core-a-cryptodb
turns: Cryptosporidium parvum IOWA-ATCC genes whose product description matches mucin*.
Just a question, don't change the strategy: how many genes would mucin* match if every text field were searched instead of the product field alone, and how many of those are beyond the ones here?
rationale: A comparison's counts are in the reply, rendered from the comparison the turn ran: 84 genes over every text field and 82 genes beyond the 2 the product-field step holds, while the strategy keeps its one text step.

provenance.curatorNote: A text step bound to the product field carries the vocabulary value product. On build 71, mucin* over C. parvum IOWA-ATCC matches 2 genes in the product field (CPATCC_0009860, CPATCC_0031660) and 84 over every text field, 82 of them outside the product-field result.
